name: 44126 · Fairview Park, OH
findings: ZIP 44126 (Fairview Park) has 87 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44126 (Fairview Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
